captions.caption: A red post driver is positioned over a wooden fence post in a green field.
The post driver strikes the top of the wooden post for the first time.
The machine prepares for another strike as the post begins to sink.
The red driver hits the wooden post again with a loud mechanical thud.
The driver is raised up while a man on a tractor monitors the depth.
Another forceful strike from the driver sends the post deeper into the ground.
The post driver resets its position for another hit on the wooden post.
The driver delivers another blow to the post while the tractor idles nearby.
The pounding continues as the wooden post is driven steadily into the soil.
A close-up strike shows the impact of the mechanical driver on the post.
The driver is lifted high again to prepare for the next downward strike.
The post driver hits the wood again, making steady progress in the field.
The mechanical arm retracts after a successful strike on the fence post.
The driver strikes the post again, with the man on the tractor adjusting controls.
The driver is raised for one of the final strikes on this wooden post.
The post driver delivers a final blow to secure the post at the right height.
A person wearing gloves uses a hammer to pound a staple into the wood.
The hammer strikes the staple to hold the wire fence against the post.
The person continues hammering the staple firmly into the side of the post.
Multiple hammer strikes are used to ensure the staple is fully embedded in wood.
The person finishes securing the first wire and moves the hammer slightly.
A second staple is hammered into the post to secure another wire strand.
The hammer hits the staple repeatedly as the person works down the post.
The staple is driven deep into the wood to provide a secure fence line.
The person delivers the final hammer strikes for the second staple on the post.
The person stops hammering and prepares to move to the next section of the fence.
The scene cuts to a man in a grey t-shirt talking to the camera inside a truck.
The man explains that they have finished pounding fence posts for the day.
He comments on the extreme heat they experienced while working in the field.
The man mentions a high heat index while the truck drives down the road.
He continues his explanation of the weather conditions and their impact on work.
The passenger looks towards the driver as they converse during the drive.
The man speaks about the humidity levels while gesturing with his hands.
He looks back at the camera to continue his vlog-style update for viewers.
The man mentions that his face got sunburned from being out in the sun.
He points to his red face to show the effects of the sun exposure.
The driver also reacts to the heat, touching his own face in agreement.
The camera captures the driver rubbing his face as they talk about the sunburn.
The driver rubs his nose and eyes, appearing tired after the day's labor.
The passenger continues talking about how the sun affected their work performance.
He notes that the sweat stings his sunburned skin while he talks.
The man makes a face, indicating the discomfort of the stinging sweat.
He looks out the front windshield briefly before returning focus to the camera.
The man begins to sign off, thanking the audience for watching the video.
He mentions their various social media accounts for followers to check out.
The man lists platforms like Facebook and Instagram as he talks.
He continues the list with Twitter and Snapchat, encouraging viewer engagement.
The man looks around the truck interior as he finishes his closing remarks.
He announces their plan to go get ice cream to reward themselves.
The passenger smiles at the thought of the cold treat after a hot day.
The truck is seen moving through a sunny, tree-lined landscape.
The man finishes his sentence and looks away from the camera.
A jump cut shows the two men now holding soft-serve ice cream cones.
The passenger takes a huge, enthusiastic bite out of his ice cream cone.
The driver is also seen eating his ice cream while keeping an eye on the road.
Both men enjoy their cold ice cream cones inside the moving vehicle.
The passenger holds his ice cream cone and looks satisfied with the treat.
They continue eating as the "How Farms Work" logo begins to appear.
The logo and social media icons fade in over the scene of them eating.
The video ends with the full logo and social media links displayed on screen.
